description: The native reference application regenerated 80 independent TX controls on 2026-09-19. Expected terminal fit comes from native parent fallback geometry. Input contains effective native text formatting at the authored width and height; font-rule cases use the final font only to verify measurement, not to test or implement font search. Glyph advances and font metrics were independently recorded in Chromium. Covers explicit/automatic lines, font-rule failure, paragraph indentation, and zero/negative content widths from large margins. Source bullet declarations were removed by native TX and do not establish bullet behavior. No native geometry is a measurement input. Height policy is supplied by this caller: font fitting requires natural height, while no-rule acceptance rejects extra wraps only when they exceed height. Layout orchestration and font quantization are not implemented by this measurement test. Paragraph percentage spacing is preserved in the measured input. Complete-span glyph requests were independently recaptured from the browser after the wrapping update; all previous glyph metrics and native expectations remain exact.
